future_trace_schema.observation: required object containing public candidate-visible fields only
future_trace_schema.prediction: required raw candidate prediction, not expected label or truth key
future_trace_schema.serialized_candidate_state: required object or hash for replay input; not a truth source
future_trace_schema.environment_hidden_truth_hash: required hash of environment-owned hidden truth
future_trace_schema.baseline_invocation: required object naming independent baseline function and input ids
future_trace_schema.replay_recomputation_input: required object containing serialized candidate state plus new observation

replay_definition.score_against: environment-owned hidden truth and harness-owned metric
